description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - The Insurers (Customer Due Diligence) Rules, No. 1 of 2019
reasoning: The gazette content consists of rules made by the Financial Intelligence Unit under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, No. 6 of 2006.
